Baik Assistant Professor of Business Administration Assistant Professor of Business Administration Read more Brian Baik is an assistant professor in the Accounting and Management Unit at Harvard Business School. He teaches the Financial Reporting and Control course in the MBA required curriculum. Professor Baik studies how information, financial reporting, and corporate taxes matter for PE/VC investors or startup firms.
